messages:
alice: Heads-up — product asked for a single shareable dashboard for runtime metrics that we can give to customers, but security wants stricter audit trails and internal-only views. can we sync?
ben: I skimmed the ask. two main needs: (1) customer-facing, sanitized view (no request ids or full logs), (2) internal ops view with traces+KV cache hits.
carla: +1. we also need RBAC for who can create a share link vs who can just view. current console only has org-admin / viewer roles, not fine-grained sharing.
derek: question — should this be a new endpoint in the console API (POST /dashboard/shares) or re-use existing dashboard export route? API debate: dedicated resource for shares gives better auditability.
eva: security perspective: any share that can be accessed externally must be tied to a delegatable role and create an audit event with uid, ip, and token-scope. also retention policy for logs (30/90/365). tagging required. :lock:
sec-bot: automated note: PCI/ISO customers require an exportable audit manifest for any externally shared dashboard.
alice: propose we model shares as their own resource w/ fields: owner, visibility (internal/customer/embeddable), allowed_roles, blacklisted_metrics, created_at, expires_at. also expose an audit manifest endpoint. thoughts?
ben: sounds good. what about telemetry inputs? runtime needs to emit metric dimensions we don't have: model_variant, route_policy, quant_profile, kv_cache_hit boolean. ops needs p50/p95 latency per model_variant.
carla: adding dimensions is fine but will affect TSDB cardinality. we need sampling rules and reasonable tag sets. prefer enums for model_variant and quant_profile.
derek: Implementation plan: infra emits new tags, runtime team adds to metrics pipeline, eng-platform updates dashboard templates and API shapes, security signs off on audit manifest. estimate 2 sprints.
eva: Also require a "sanitization" config for customer views: redact request_id, user_input, full prompt. replace with hash maybe. must be reversible for compliance requests via a sealed access workflow.
alice: UX note: in console share dialog we need options: expiration, allow-embed toggle, restrict to customer account ids, and request-audit-manifest checkbox. default to internal-only. keep dialog small.
ben: For RBAC: add permission verbs: dashboard:share, dashboard:share.manage, dashboard:view.audit. Map them to existing roles but allow orgs to define custom roles.
carla: Can we leverage current audit pipeline? there's an append-only S3 bucket + indexer. we need per-share-indexing. will add share_id tag to events.
derek: API sketch (pseudo):
```
POST /api/v1/dashboards/123/shares
{
  "visibility": "customer",
  "expires_at": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z",
  "allowed_roles": ["customer_support"],
  "sanitize": ["prompt", "request_id"]
}
```
Response includes share_id and audit_manifest_url.
eva: please include key rotation note: share tokens should be short-lived and tied to a scoped credential. for embeddables, use signed JWT with audience/customer check.
alice: next steps: derek to draft API PR + data model, ben to draft RBAC mapping, carla to propose TSDB cardinality constraints, eva to write audit retention & sanitization requirements. sync on Monday 10am.
ben: I'll also add a small eval: sample 10 dashboards and run a sanitization pass to estimate lost fields.
alice: thanks — putting this in a ticket and linking the API sketch. will ping product for priority. :calendar:
